title: Documentation territory configuration
description: Externalised territory list read by docs-gate.cjs at startup. Satisfies FR-022: territories are configuration, not enforcement logic. Today this list is an inline const at docs-gate.cjs:21-25 and FR-022 is unsatisfied.

version.description: Schema version. The gate MUST refuse to start on an unrecognised version rather than guess.

packageTerritories.description: Governs the PKG_RE fall-through in ownerOf(). Without this, any **/node_modules/<pkg> path is a territory owned by <pkg>, making the enforced surface every installed package. See data-model.md section 5.

mode.description: 'allowlist' restricts package ownership to ids listed in territories with enforced:true. 'off' disables the fall-through entirely. The legacy fall-through-everything behaviour is deliberately not expressible.

id.description: MUST match the library name docs-mcp-server knows, exactly as accepted by search_docs' `library` input, because receipts are keyed on that input value.

items.description: Anchored regex source matching owned paths. MUST anchor to a path root or a complete segment. Unanchored patterns produce false ownership: the existing claude-flow pattern (^|\/)\.claude-flow(\/|$) matches /home/nick/dev/.specify/.claude-flow and yields an unsatisfiable denial today.

enforced.description: true = blocking (FR-019a: no advisory mode, no per-invocation override). MUST be true only where documentation is actually indexed. Initial true set is ['omniroute'] alone per FR-019b; zod is indexed but not yet enforced.

hints.description: Shown in permissionDecisionReason on denial. MUST NOT name a command or path that does not exist. The current fallback hint `claude-flow --help` names an uninstalled binary.

hints: Read a file under the omniroute source tree
